desc: A command touched paths or state outside the task's declared file list.
A stage or wave boundary was crossed without emitting its handoff block.
A task passed review and the green gate on its first round, with no rework.
A fix satisfied the finding's wording while missing the convention behind it.
The green gate caught a regression that the review round had already accepted.
A dispatch brief omitted or misstated a field its executor requires.
Captured evidence covered less than the whole verification gate command.
Content was copied into a second file instead of citing its single owner.
A reviewer's own judgment, tools, or output shape was conflated with another role's.
A pinned interface or a side effect changed without being reported first.
A credential reached a file, or the gate that would have caught one never ran.
Authored text stated a fact about the repo that was never checked against it.
